editor.userTitle: User type: its token is added to the request
editor.confirmLeave: The request has unsaved changes: leave it anyway?

response.waitingLogin: Waiting for the login in the browser…
vault.stillLocked: Master password not entered: secrets not available
sectionDlg.name: Name
sectionDlg.projectHint: Optional: used to find the Express routes in the code and to propose the base URL from PORT in .env.
sectionDlg.proposeTitle: Propose the URL from PORT in the project's .env
sectionDlg.portDefault: No PORT in the project's .env files: 3000 proposed
sectionDlg.variablesHint: Used as {{name}} in URL, query, headers and body. baseUrl, username, password and token are reserved.
sectionDlg.nameRequired: Enter the name of the section

sectionDlg.confirmDelete.one: Delete the section {name} and its request?
sectionDlg.confirmDelete.other: Delete the section {name} and its {count} requests?

users.title: Users · {section}
users.hint: Every request uses a user type (or none). The token is obtained when needed and kept only in memory: it is lost when Kelbo restarts.
users.loginOpened: Login opened in the browser: complete it there

users.confirmDelete.one: Delete the user type {name}? The request that uses it will be left without authorization.
users.confirmDelete.other: Delete the user type {name}? The {count} requests that use it will be left without authorization.

userDlg.name: Name
userDlg.nameRequired: Enter the name of the user type
userDlg.secretHint: Encrypted with the master password of the Database section, never saved in clear.
userDlg.manualHint: The token is pasted from the users dialog (with an optional expiry); for JWTs the expiry is read from the exp claim.
userDlg.loginBodyHint: {{username}} and {{password}} are replaced with the credentials (escaped for JSON and form); the section variables work too.
userDlg.tokenPathHint: In the JSON response (data.accessToken) or header:Authorization
userDlg.expiresPathHint: Path in the JSON response; otherwise the JWT exp is used
userDlg.issuerHint: The endpoints are read from /.well-known/openid-configuration; or enter them by hand.
userDlg.redirectUri: Redirect URI registered in the client
userDlg.redirectHint: Kelbo listens on that port only during the login.
userDlg.containerHint: Needs the "Open external links in a container" add-on.
after.title: Actions after the token
after.hint: Requests run right after the token is obtained, with the new token in the header (e.g. choosing the tenant, CSRF token). Variables are extracted from the responses and used as {{name}} in the requests of this user type.
after.extractHint: JSON path (data.id) or header:Name. A variable called token takes the place of the token (e.g. a second token obtained through an exchange).
token.title: Token · {name}
token.hint: Only the value, without "Bearer". Kept in memory until Kelbo restarts.
token.expiresHint: For JWTs the expiry is also read from the exp claim.
routes.title: Express routes · {section}

routes.noEntry.one: Entry file not found: {count} file analysed
routes.noEntry.other: Entry file not found: {count} files analysed

routes.autoloaders: Dynamic route loading (readdirSync) in {list}: the prefixes of those routers must be completed by hand.
routes.hint: Static analysis of the code (JS and TS): relative require/import and prefixes of app.use and router.use. NestJS, Fastify and Koa are not supported.
routes.importHint: The request uses {{baseUrl}} followed by the path; parameters such as :id can be replaced later.
routes.completeHint: Replace the parts between « » with the real value: {list}
routes.stillIncomplete: The path still contains parts to complete (« »)
oauthPage.done: Signed in as {user}: Kelbo has the token and the request goes on.
oauthPage.failed: Kelbo didn't get the token: check the user type settings and try again.
users.loginPending: Login in progress in the browser
users.browserFailed: The browser did not open ({error}): open the link next to this
browser.label: Browser for logins:
browser.title: Browser for OAuth logins
browser.hint: Executable of the browser where OAuth logins open (e.g. Firefox, for containers). Empty: the default browser. It applies to every user type, on this computer only: it is not exported.
browser.hintWsl: Kelbo runs in WSL: logins open in the Windows browser, given with its path under /mnt/c (e.g. Firefox, for containers). Empty: Windows Firefox when it is installed in the standard folder, otherwise the Windows default browser. It applies to every user type, on this computer only: it is not exported.
browser.wslNotFound: Windows Firefox not found in the standard folder: without a path the Windows default browser opens (containers need Firefox).
userDlg.clientSecretHint: Optional: needed by «confidential» clients (in Keycloak: Client authentication on), also with PKCE. Encrypted with the master password.
body.fileHint: The file is read when the request is sent and sent as it is (max 50 MB): absolute path or relative to the folder of the project linked to the section, variables allowed. Content-Type from the extension unless set in the headers.
body.formHint: multipart/form-data: file fields hold a path (absolute or relative to the project), read when sending; the Content-Type with the boundary is set by Kelbo.
response.downloaded: Binary content ({size}) saved to Downloads as {name}
response.binaryTooLarge: Binary content of {size}: too large to be saved (max 50 MB)
